summary.intent: Execute Phase 35 of the cipher-box project: migrate the TEE worker to Phala Cloud CVM, including moving to apps/, integrating shared packages, adding unit tests, Phala SDK integration, staging infra updates, and deploying the CVM to Phala Cloud.
summary.outcome: All 6 plans completed across 4 waves. TEE worker moved to apps/tee-worker/, 56 unit tests passing, Phala SDK integrated, CVM deployed and verified on Phala Cloud production infrastructure. PR #395 created, security review conducted with all HIGH/MEDIUM findings fixed, lint and review comments resolved.

repo: The phase was named 'phala-testnet-tee-migration' but Phala Cloud has no separate testnet — the free tier ($20 credit) runs on the same production nodes (Intel TDX hardware, dstack-pha-prod5) as paid deployments
Secrets stored in HANDOFF.json and .continue-here.md are committed to the branch and pushed to remote — any credentials in those files are exposed in git history
The 'entire' branch stores conversation transcripts as JSONL checkpoints; secrets shared in conversation messages end up in these transcripts
CI deploy-staging.yml has build-tee and deploy-tee-phala jobs that automatically build/push image and deploy CVM when a staging-v* tag is pushed
TEE_WORKER_SECRET must be kept in sync between the API's .env on the VPS and GitHub staging secrets — both are set from STAGING_TEE_WORKER_SECRET
Git worktree agents occasionally conflict on git config lock when spawned in parallel — sequential execution avoids this
pnpm workspace hoisting can prevent TypeScript from resolving package types even after explicit install; static imports with type-only fallback resolve this

code.finding: Original code called getKeypair() instead of getPublicKey(), leaking the private key into route scope — security bug caught in simplify review

DNS pinning via hostname rewrite in URL broke TLS SNI/certificate validation — correct fix is undici Agent with custom lookup function that resolves DNS independently and connects by IP while preserving original Host header
parseInt(process.env.TEE_CURRENT_EPOCH || '1', 10) can yield NaN if env var is non-numeric — needs Number.isFinite guard with explicit fallback to 1
Unmatched route label should be '/:unmatched' (not 'unmatched') to match API's http-metrics.interceptor.ts:40 pattern for consistent Prometheus metrics
SSRF check compared `endpoint` variable instead of `protocol` against 'cipherbox' — always evaluated truthy, bypassing the cipherbox protocol guard
FetchFn type was exported from types.ts but not re-exported from the public index — consumers had to use ProviderOptions['fetchFn'] or deep-import
Hand-rolled CID regex validation replaced with CID.parse() from multiformats package (already a dependency in @cipherbox/crypto) — standard library handles all CID versions and multibase encodings

workflow: GSD pause-work/resume-work enables cross-machine session handoffs — push branch, pull on target machine, /gsd:resume-work restores full context including credentials
Credentials placed in HANDOFF.json for session continuity should be rotated immediately after the handoff is consumed — the files persist in git history even after deletion
Security review should be run before shipping any crypto/TEE implementation — catching the getKeypair() vs getPublicKey() bug before merge was high value
When spawning parallel executor agents, running hooks with --no-verify and validating post-wave catches issues without blocking parallel execution
Phala CLI phala deploy reads docker-compose.yml with envsubst for environment substitution — TEE_WORKER_SECRET and other env vars must be exported before deploy

friction: Wave 2 parallel agents failed: 35-02 hit a git config lock conflict, 35-03 hit a usage limit mid-execution — required sequential retry after cleanup
Usage limit (extra usage reset at 11am Europe/Berlin) interrupted wave 2 execution mid-session
gsd-tools init failed when run from main repo while on phase-35 worktree branch — had to detect and switch to running from worktree path
STATE.md merge conflicts occurred when merging worktree agent changes back to phase branch — required manual conflict resolution multiple times
undici package types not resolved by TypeScript despite explicit pnpm add — required static import and tsconfig adjustment
Phala CLI phala restart returned success but CVM took 3+ minutes to come back up — required repeated health check polling
Docker not available on dev machine (runs on remote host 192.168.133.12) — required session transfer via GSD pause/resume workflow for image build
open_items: Phala Cloud API key (phak_y8Dc5p3u-...) and TEE worker secret exposed in git history on phase-35 branch and entire/checkpoints transcript — old values inert after rotation but history not purged
Connection probe deduplication: connection-test.ts reimplements probe logic that exists in sdk-core — deferred as significant refactor
String key material zeroing (clearBytes vs .fill(0)) is ineffective in JS due to string immutability — acknowledged limitation, no fix possible at language level

DNS rebinding protection in ssrf-validation.ts: undici Agent with custom lookup is correct fix but relies on undici being available in Node.js runtime — should verify Node version compatibility in production CVM
Security review LOW-02 (health endpoint reveals mode/epoch info) accepted as operational necessity but not hardened — could add auth to health endpoint in future
No integration tests for the full IPNS republish cycle against a running CVM — only unit tests and manual verification during checkpoint task
Phase name 'phala-testnet-tee-migration' is a misnomer — code uses production Phala infrastructure. Directory name left as-is to avoid breaking cross-references
